reviewScope: All recorded or explicitly stated LoL leans, shadow markets, and unplaced official recommendations from 2026-08-01.

gradedSnapshotSummary.warning: This snapshot view overstates sample size because several BLG-JDG entries are repeated observations of the same evolving thesis.

unplacedOfficialRecommendationSummary.assessment: Selection quality was positive, but both winning moneylines were missed because of live movement or immediate state change. The correct improvement is faster verdict delivery, not weaker expiry gates.

leanOnlyGradedSummary.assessment: The lean-only sample was negative. Kill-total Overs were the weakest group, while the large positive-underdog kill cushion and one duration Over were directionally correct.

ungradedLeanSummary.reason: Exact final kill total for DK vs Gen.G Game 2 was not supplied, so Over 27.5 and Under 24.5 cannot be graded honestly.

records.event: Nongshim RedForce vs BNK FEARX — Game 2
records.processReview: The model had valid current-map confirmations: kill lead, objective control, structure edge, and an active Olaf breakpoint. The main failure was response and execution latency; the market moved materially before placement.

records.event: LGD Gaming vs Top Esports — Game 1
records.processReview: The selection was supported by gold, structures, objectives, and a live Naafiri breakpoint. TES then secured two immediate kills, correctly expiring the recommendation. The model read was useful; the no-placement decision was also correct.
The model confused structural control with kill suppression and failed to budget remaining Baron, dragon, inhibitor, and base-defense fights. This was addressed by v0.3.12.
Post-draft volatility was noted, but no exact final kill total was supplied. The later market and state changed materially, so this cannot be merged with subsequent kill-total assessments.
At 14:09 the map was low-kill, but both teams retained functional damage and layered engage. Exact final kills were not supplied, so no outcome grade is assigned.

failedTheses: JDG +8.5 kill handicap after line compression
independentThesisReview.warning: The thesis count is descriptive, not statistically reliable. Markets, matches, and repeated live states are correlated and selectively observed.

marketConclusions.moneylines: Best shadow category so far. Two valid live reads won. Preserve the two-confirmation and expiry rules; improve verdict speed.
marketConclusions.killTotalOvers: Weakest lean category. Do not use draft engage density alone. A future kill-Over lean should require observed two-sided structured-fight conversion or a clearly demonstrated high kill-velocity window.
marketConclusions.killTotalUnders: The late DK-Gen.G miss exposed a fight-budget failure already addressed by v0.3.12. The ungraded Game 2 Under 24.5 cannot be used as evidence.
marketConclusions.positiveUnderdogKillHandicaps: Strongly line-sensitive. +10.5 survived; +8.5 did not. Every line change must be independently reassessed, and a shrinking cushion plus widening structural deficit is a material downgrade.
marketConclusions.durationOvers: One lean won while three official duration Overs lost. Do not relax v0.3.13 from one winning shadow result; the lean had a different, more developed slow-state basis.

modelActions.reason: The main negative lean evidence comes from one correlated BLG-JDG map, so a new hard version would overfit.
operationalChanges: Do not classify a kill-total Over as LEAN from champion engage density alone.
Require at least one observed two-sided structured-fight conversion or a high-velocity kill window before a kill-Over lean.
Front-load moneyline verdicts once all gates pass, while retaining state and price expiry.
Treat a two-kill handicap movement as a materially different risk profile.
Continue reporting shadow outcomes separately from official P/L and probation.
Keep the v0.3.13 duration-over restrictions unchanged.
